history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of these arms was read (borg-zoo#738; borg-reborn-rs#1134; evidence borg-cemetery#146). Three arms on
track-p 1c071812: ctl (shipped); pkg (escape_phase_lost_danger_percent 50, caution_ranged_only 1, caution_ranged_vs_immobile 2,
caution_confused_clw_cure 1; caution_recall_survival 1 as shipped); pkgnoimm (pkg without caution_ranged_vs_immobile 2). Prior evidence:
local replays of the 25 deaths of run 45121432449 rescued at the fatal point phase50 5, ranged_only 4, immobile2 3, conf 2 (each alone, none
killed any of 18 sampled survivors; the package was not replayed); borg-zoo#740 on the same build, starts 1-900: ranged 12 deaths vs ctl 13
(2/1), immobile2 17 (2/6), DL3 reached 215 and 221 vs 199. Plan: pilot (classes-18) as the gate, then classes-1800 starts 1-900
(verysmall, small-rest, medium, big, read pooled).
Tier small-rest: classes-1800 starts 46-90, 100,000 turns. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped;
stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm. Report per arm and class: deaths and causes (poison, floating eye/patch/jelly, while
confused apart), rescued and newly killed against ctl and pkg against pkgnoimm (exact McNemar), CL and depth, DL3/DL5 reached, identical
plays; Phase Door reads and "Fixing Confusion" notes per game. Descriptive (RULES 14).
